title: DBF-1.1 Design Baseline Freeze 1.1 - hall_icp_neutralizer (DCR-DBF1-002: FE-derived H-1 B(z))

owner_decision_summary.dbf_1: freeze one specific current design for hall_icp_neutralizer today, before M2: intake, compressor, H1 geometry, magnetic target, ICP geometry, RF operating envelope, power allocation, mass policy / Xe reference load, thermal topology, primary / backup materials, reference host-drag model
owner_decision_summary.source_rule: only values or candidates already in the repository; no invented physics; where evidence is incomplete, freeze the selected engineering assumption with its evidence class and uncertainty instead of leaving the variable open

fixed_values.H1: RP-1: d_mean 70 mm, h 12 mm, L/h 8.6 (~103 mm length)
fixed_values.power: 1,350 W design allocation / 1,500 W RFP gate; 300 W common-load allocation
fixed_values.mass: 10 % system mass-margin policy; <= 34 kg nominal-dry target; 2 kg reference Xe load

owner_decision_summary.intake_compressor: select and freeze one baseline from existing registered candidates; if none closes both flow and drag, record a BASELINE_DEFICIENCY, not a reason to continue trading
owner_decision_summary.materials: select and freeze primary + backup Hall / ICP electrode materials from the existing candidate register
owner_decision_summary.host_drag: freeze a proposal / reference host-spacecraft drag geometry so M2 can calculate T-D, labelled reference pending customer ICD
owner_decision_summary.change_control: after DBF-1 no design value changes merely to improve M2 performance; any change needs a formal DCR identifying the physical / evidence reason before rerun

authority_rule: this JSON is authoritative; DBF1_1_v1.md restates it; dbf1_1_config_v1.json is the machine-readable subset the closure harness reads through abep-config (abep_config::baseline::load_dbf1_1), pinned by dbf1_1_lock_v1.json
source_rule: only values or candidates already in the repository (A9.37); no invented physics; where evidence is incomplete the selected engineering assumption is frozen with its evidence class and uncertainty

status_vocabulary.FROZEN: the value is frozen as the design value; its evidence supports it at the stated class
status_vocabulary.FROZEN_ASSUMPTION: the value is frozen as the selected engineering assumption; the evidence is incomplete and the class / uncertainty say how (A9.37: never left open)
status_vocabulary.REFERENCE_PENDING_ICD: a frozen reference value standing in for a customer / host ICD that does not exist; replaced only by that ICD through a DCR
status_vocabulary.BASELINE_DEFICIENCY: the value is frozen (it is the design) and a registered closure condition is known not to be met by it; the deficiency record gives the numbers. Not a reason to keep trading (A9.37)

evidence_attributes.evidence_class: plain-language class (owner-fixed / literature / model-derived / engineering assumption / reference pending ICD)
evidence_attributes.quantity_type: docs/EVIDENCE.md quantity type (measured, digitized, inferred, reconstructed, model-derived, assumed) or owner-allocation / as-reported

hardware_configuration.meaning: the envelope hardware configuration (geometry, bz_shape) of DBF-1.1; B_peak, V_d and mdot are operating variables

selection_rules.pool: DS-F7-PARETO members (admitted F7 Pareto blocks, f7_pareto_blocks_v1) with context_role ARCHITECTURE_CONTEXT (an actual filter element; FC00 contexts are reference bounds only, A9.13 S6.5) whose F1 intake candidate is in DS-F1-ADMISSIBLE for that context's surface scenario (FEASIBLE_AT_STATE at every required state under F1 C-CONV and the intake-face drag filter C-DRAG-RFP <= 25 mN)
selection_rules.unit: a design vector (intake candidate, filter case, compressor, plenum V, P_set); its admitted F7 Pareto memberships across surface scenarios
keys_in_order: 1. maximise n_s = the number of admitted surface scenarios in which the design vector is an F7 Pareto member (scenario robustness first: A9.13 S6.16, no favourable surface scenario is chosen)
2. maximise the worst-state delivered flow in its worst covered scenario: min over covered scenarios of the committed statewise-minimum mdot_delivered_min_kgps
3. tie-break: minimise the maximum compressor electrical power P_compressor_el_max_W
4. tie-break: minimise the compressor mass m_compressor_max_kg
selection_rules.not_used: mass, Hall performance and M2 results are not selection keys (A9.37: select by flow and drag; mass is assessed against the frozen policy and its shortfall recorded as a deficiency)

selection_rules.pool: P4 candidate register (p4_anode_materials_v1 candidates) with Q0-matrix role CANDIDATE, a bulk (uncoated) material and an assigned R8 coupon; 316L excluded (REJECTED_AS_CURRENT_BASELINE for the flight anode; Q0 role ENGINEERING_REFERENCE_CONTROL_ONLY); reference / negative controls, reserve and non-Q0 entries excluded; coatings excluded (coating thickness / record TBD)
keys_in_order: 1. maximise the number of populated datasheet properties (P4 evidence_coverage)
2. a family whose R8 status is 'test only as hypothesis-control' (alumina formers: possible insulating scale on an electron- / ion-collecting electrode) ranks after the others
backup: the highest-ranked candidate of a different oxide-former family than the primary (common-mode independence)

selection_rules.pool: the declared reference drag cases of spacecraft_reference_drag_v1 (register crates/abep-mission/data/spacecraft_reference_register_v1.json) whose reference area does not already include the intake (SRD-04: the DBF-1 intake-face drag is a separate term)
keys_in_order: 1. applicability: the source spacecraft's altitude range overlaps 180-230 km AND its stated propulsion power class is <= 1.5 kW (cases without a stated power are not applicable)
2. among applicable cases the largest C_D A_ref (conservative: the frozen reference never favours T - D)
selection_rules.sensitivity: every pool case is reported by M2 as a drag sensitivity (SRD-03: no case is representative); the classification uses the frozen case only

baseline_deficiencies.category: DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT (A9.35: A4-REG-01 open, no registered envelope bound)

baseline_deficiencies.closure_condition: nominal dry <= 34.0 kg; wet < 40 kg at the 2 kg reference Xe load
baseline_deficiencies.finding: the current provisional planning roll-up (owner MEV lines + evidence floors; not a CBE) is above the 34 kg nominal-dry target and the 40 kg wet limit at 2 kg Xe (MASS INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE / NOT_YET_CLOSED); planning values are never eligible for a non-closure (HR-07)

baseline_deficiencies.closure_condition: an H-1 B(z) from FEMM of MC-1 or a measured map (H1F-BZ-01)
baseline_deficiencies.finding: the simulated field is a P5-shape surrogate scaled into the H1F-BZ-03 band: a Hall non-closure under it is never eligible (envelope prereg bz_family classification_effect)

closure.residual: a measured H-1 map remains an engineering-model verification item (H1F-EX-08, H1F-MC-09); the FE field covers the pre-shielding flat-pole circuit only

baseline_deficiencies.closure_condition: ICP I_e,cap evaluable (NP-ICP v2 inputs registered and the AIR / Xe rate sets admitted)

not_registered: absorbed RF power / P2 coupling evidence
electrode potentials and bias range (P1-IT-36 / P1-IT-18)

baseline_deficiencies.finding: with the frozen geometry and RF, I_e,cap stays NOT_EVALUATED: the remaining inputs are operating points or evidence, not design values

change_control.rule: after DBF-1 no design value changes merely to improve M2 performance; any change needs a formal DCR naming the physical / evidence reason, approved before rerun (A9.37). Supplying converged Hall envelope data is an input completion, not a design change, and needs no DCR; DBF-1.1 is the successor created by the approved DCR-DBF1-002 and is under the same DCR process

not: not a PASS / qualification / flight baseline approval
not a change to any RFP requirement, owner decision or admitted / scored record
not an M2 or M3 result

config_registration.loader: abep_config::baseline::load_dbf1 (sha256 pin DBF1_CONFIG_SHA256 + lock DBF1_LOCK_SHA256, fail closed)
config_registration.why_not_config_manifest: config/MANIFEST.json is pinned (sha256 3a85581e...) inside immutable committed records that tests regenerate byte for byte (NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE closure_run_today_v1.json, closure_run_m1_dryrun_v1.json, closure_run_m1_dryrun_v2.json); listing a new file there would change that pin and break their reproduction. DBF-1 is therefore pinned like the operating scenario (a code pin in abep-config), not through config/MANIFEST.json

lineage.approval_authority: coordinator ruling under owner delegation A9.34 (lane-level calls between milestones; this DCR changes no architecture item, no RFP requirement and no admitted / scored result); the owner may overrule, in which case DBF-1.1 is withdrawn and DBF-1 stays governing
approval_conditions: DBF-1.1 is built as new files with its own lock; DBF-1 and every record computed on it stay immutable history
surrogate and FE-field Hall records are never pooled
a Hall run citing the FE field needs a new NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE addendum committed before the run
measured B(z) on the engineering model remains an EM verification item
lineage.rule: DBF-1 and every record computed on it stay immutable history; DBF-1.1 changes DBF1-BZ-04 only (plus the closure of DBF1-BD-05 it implies); surrogate and FE-field Hall records are never pooled
